lines.input: Do what I ask, or you'll regret it.
Out of my way, you useless fool.
Please, I'm begging you. I'm in real trouble, and I've nowhere else to turn.
Someone as clever as you can surely see this is the right thing to do.
I'll be honest: I can't pay much now, but help me tonight and I'll pay you back twice over, in writing, with my name on it.
